mercury.fact: Mercury is the smallest planet in our Solar System.

venus.fact: A day on Venus is longer than its year.

earth.fact: Earth is the only known planet that supports life.

mars.fact: Mars contains Olympus Mons, the tallest volcano in the Solar System.

jupiter.fact: Jupiter is the largest planet in our Solar System.

saturn.fact: Saturn's rings are made mostly of ice particles with some rocky debris.

uranus.fact: Uranus rotates on its side because it was likely struck by a massive object long ago.

neptune.fact: Neptune has the fastest winds in the Solar System, reaching over 2,000 km/h.
